title: The Battle for Fort Hraggstad
description: Galmar Stone-Fist orders the player to join the Stormcloak assault on Fort Hraggstad, the Imperial Legion's last stronghold in Haafingar before the final push on Solitude.

base_facts: I am Galmar Stone-Fist, second-in-command of the Stormcloak rebellion under Ulfric Stormcloak.
I direct military operations for the Stormcloaks across Skyrim.

ORDERS_FROM_GALMAR: I have sent the player to assist in taking Fort Hraggstad from the Imperials.
FORT_CAPTURED: Fort Hraggstad has fallen to Stormcloak forces, eliminating the last Imperial stronghold in Haafingar.
The path to Solitude is now open for the final assault against the Empire.
The player should report back for a leveled gold reward; the next quest will begin automatically upon doing so.
The next quest in the Stormcloak campaign is the Battle for Solitude.

beats.comment: Galmar gives orders to join the assault on Fort Hraggstad.
Player joins the Stormcloaks at the staging area and begins the assault on the fort.
Fort Hraggstad is taken; the way to Solitude is clear for the final battle.
